conventions.score_arithmetic: compute in arbitrary precision, render at 6dp half-even; comparisons on rendered values
conventions.canonical_json: UTF-8, sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace; two implementations must reproduce identical bytes

roles.labeling: model-assisted development labels; independent blinded human adjudicator required for external release claim
roles.independence_rule: 24h owner approval is an internal control only; external independence requires separate hidden-test custodian and blinded adjudicator, precommitted protocol and metric, one final access, immutable access log; failed sealed tests are retired

external_release_gate.solo_fallback_claim: internal evaluation only; prospective post-freeze cases, blinded attribution, no reuse after failure

id_assignment: random ULID per candidate at generation time, logged; IDs carry no ordering semantics; tie and baseline resolution by lexicographic ID order is therefore random and documented

eligibility_baseline.selection: lowest lexicographic candidate ID among eligible; responses labeled unverified

cal_ll_map.rounding: six decimal places, half-even after affine map
cal_ll_map.raw_ll_definition: mean per-answer-token natural log probability under the fixed model digest and prompt format; prompt tokens excluded

grounded_v1.release_gate: inactive outside pure-policy fixtures until model-specific calibration map and validation are frozen

class_routing.multi_class: normalize each class and route separately; equal profiles combine; unequal grounded profiles are incomparable and abstain PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE; any terminal abstention applies
class_routing.unclassified: unknown, empty or missing class normalizes to unclassified before rule matching; grounded requests with active verifier use grounded_support_only

input_class_normalization.multi_class: normalize each member, deduplicate, then combine; conflicting profiles abstain PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE

class_routing.matching: omitted boolean field is a wildcard; class * is a wildcard; exactly one rule must match after class normalization

n1_handling: single candidate still receives all hard gates, per-claim support validation, feature validation and the profile tau; only pairwise comparison is skipped

budgets.source: Hestia local GGUF baseline (qwen2.5-14b-instruct) + Kybernetes turn budget benchmark on sovereign workstation (16 GB unified target; deadline_fraction=0.40, max_candidates=2)

audit_card.confidence_method: one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson bounds; Bonferroni family-wise 0.050000 across six critical slices times two metrics
audit_card.verifier_confidence_calibration: reliability map versioned per verifier version; per_claim_min applies to CALIBRATED confidence
audit_card.reactivation: new passing Dokime bundle only; rollback tested

adjudication_queue.overflow: typed VERIFIER_UNAVAILABLE for affected grounded requests; never silently mark supported

audit_card.correlated_error_audit: false-support measured conditional on same-model candidates; independence preferred, risk recorded if impossible
audit_card.brevity_bias_note: mean-over-claims ranking prefers few-claim answers; accepted as a safety-leaning bias, recorded here as a normative choice

false_support.denominator: independently adjudicated verifier-supported claims in the slice
false_support.numerator: claims adjudicated unsupported despite verifier supported

extraction_recall.denominator: independently adjudicated material claims in source answers in the slice

audit_card.slice_gate: each named critical slice must meet both count minima and both confidence-bound gates; overlapping cases may count in multiple slices; global minimum alone never suffices

retention.rule: deletion invalidates dependent recomputation; decision replay survives on redacted logs; what remains auditable is recorded per deletion

reason_mapping.precedence_scope: terminal abstention only, after routing, hard gates, feature checks and score threshold; never overrides selected survivor
reason_mapping.partial_generation_failure_with_valid_su: selected with counted upstream warning; not aggregate failure

generation_policy.partial_failure_with_valid_survivor: select survivor if it passes all gates and tau; log attempts and failures
